_comment: Read by scripts/check-npm-audit.py (pre-push hook and Dependency Audit). One entry per advisory, never per package. An expired entry fails the gate; renew it only with a reason that is still true.

exceptions.reason: No patched version exists (braces <= 3.0.3, last release 2024). Dev only since Tailwind 4 (#443): the one path left is eslint-config-next 15 -> @next/eslint-plugin-next -> fast-glob -> micromatch -> braces, so the pre-push gate (--omit=dev) no longer sees it and only Dependency Audit needs this entry. braces expands glob patterns when ESLint runs; nothing at runtime reaches it. @next/eslint-plugin-next 16.4 still pins fast-glob 3.3.1, so the eslint-config-next 16 migration does not remove it either.
